title: Multi-annotator contact audit: blind second pass on 10 committed contact labels

sampling.method: Deterministic: bundles sorted ascending (afn-sasebo-rally1, afn-sasebo-rally2, wavea-faead-feed, wavea-marne-dig), events earliest-first within each bundle, first 10 committed contact labels taken.
sampling.note: wavea-marne-dig sorts last and was not reached by the 10-event cap; it has no audit records.

sources.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, PD-USGov; DVIDS)

clipOffsets.afn-sasebo-rally1: clip frame n = source frame n+779 (registry trim 26.0-30.4s; visual align of clip f0 vs source frames 778-782)
clipOffsets.afn-sasebo-rally2: clip frame n = source frame n+917 (registry trim 30.6-36.0s)

sources.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, PD-USGov; DVIDS)

provenance.frameExtraction: ffmpeg select=eq(n,IDX) absolute CFR indexing; local extraction to /tmp only, no media committed; gitignored media re-downloaded from registered rights-cleared sources and hash-verified.

blindProtocol: Contact windows re-derived from direct inspection of extracted frames (ball-at-paddle adjacency or ball direction reversal across adjacent frames). Prior event times were used only to select which frame ranges to extract; prior contact values were compared only after each blind window was fixed. A green-pixel cluster tracker was used solely to locate candidate ball regions across frames; every accepted window was confirmed by eye on the frames/crops. No interpolation is reported as observation.

frameDeltas.deltaBasis: source-frame units at each recording's native fps, over the 7 events with an audit value

disputes.detail: Audit reversal window n36-37 (1201-1235ms) vs prior bracket 1083-1150ms; 3.0 frame delta.

Ball tracked in continuous free flight ~900px from target at prior contact time; no paddle near ball, no direction change between the n44-45 and n57-59 contacts. Possible double-count of the 1484ms contact.
Source video cuts to a different camera between clip n115 and n116; prior contact time is exactly n116.0. Registry describes rally1 as a single continuous shot, but a cut exists at clip ~3.85s.
Ball descends in smooth ballistic path past the player's overhead reach with no direction change across source frames 987-1002; prior note itself marks the contact as interpolated.

results.agreements: 6 of 7 events with an audit value agree within 0.5 frames and overlapping windows (317, 1484, 1934, 2900, 3834, 33442). The faead audit value matches the independent Wave C pass (33438ms) exactly.

constraints.mediaDownloadedMB: ~65 (local only, gitignored paths, rights-cleared PD-USGov sources already registered in datasets/corpus/sources.json)
